purpose: Define marketplace public/private visibility as a projection and data-release boundary over identity, Project, PortfolioCore and MeritCore semantics without changing source ownership or AccessCore authorization.

topics.name: Marketplace Visibility
topics.purpose: Define marketplace public/private visibility as a projection and data-release boundary over identity, Project, PortfolioCore and MeritCore semantics without changing source ownership or AccessCore authorization.

semantics.projection_rule: Public marketplace representation is a derived projection of explicitly eligible source fields.
semantics.privacy_rule: Private/restricted source data is not exposed solely because related public data exists.
semantics.authorization_rule: Visibility is not equivalent to write/operation authorization.
semantics.identity_rule: Public identity representation may be narrower than canonical IdentityCore data.
semantics.merit_rule: Only explicitly public/eligible MeritCore evidence/outcomes appear in public projections.
semantics.provenance_rule: Projected fields retain source/visibility policy provenance.

invariants.rule: Marketplace discovery, matching, participation, feedback and visibility semantics remain explicit and do not override Project/Merit/IAM ownership.

hard_gates.condition: private field leaks into public projection
projection duplicates source semantics as new authority
public profile exposes broader identity data than explicit visibility policy
projected merit data lacks visibility/source provenance

references.purpose: Competence history may have marketplace projection.
Visibility does not substitute for authorization.
